claims.value: LLM designed for reasoning and non-reasoning tasks. Hybrid MoE architecture with 23 Mamba-2/MoE and 6 Attention layers. 30B total parameters, 3.5B active.
claims.evidence: Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-BF16 is a large language model (LLM) trained from scratch by NVIDIA, and designed as a unified model for both reasoning and non-reasoning tasks.
The model has 3.5B active parameters and 30B parameters in total.
It responds to user queries and tasks by first generating a reasoning trace and then concluding with a final response.
The supported languages include: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, and Japanese.
The post-training data has a cutoff date of November 28, 2025.
